_comment: Three pages of the walk-in paper form, filled in, for the e2e chain's walk-in step
(Server/scripts/seedWalkIn.js). The JPEGs beside this file are RENDERED from it:
which prints the real form (src/services/walk-in/form-pdf.service.js), writes these
values into its boxes in a printed hand -- one digit per date box, names in capitals,
a tick in each apparatus box -- rasterises it and tilts it slightly, the way a phone
on a desk photographs a page. Re-run it after any change to the form's geometry
(FORM_VERSION); the step refuses images whose version differs from the form's.
Everyone here is invented: no real child, coach or phone number. The coach and team
are the desk's own, created by the step; they are on no roster.
`rows` is what the OCR must read back, field for field. The step asserts it before
anything is registered, so a misread fails the night's run instead of seeding a
